# tool.rplpeptides.com
> Free online calculators and tools for peptide research — molecular weight, dilution, molarity, purity, properties, comparison, storage stability, and amino acid conversion.
> Part of the RPL Peptides ecosystem: [rplpeptides.com](https://rplpeptides.com/) (store) | [data.rplpeptides.com](https://data.rplpeptides.com/) (reference)

## Calculators & Tools

- [Peptide Molecular Weight Calculator](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/molecular-weight-calculator/): Calculate monoisotopic and average molecular weight from amino acid sequence. Supports modifications (acetylation, amidation, disulfide bridges). Returns formula, net charge at pH 7, extinction coefficient, molar absorptivity.
- [Peptide Properties Calculator](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/peptide-property-calculator/): Compute isoelectric point (pI), net charge at user-specified pH, GRAVY hydropathicity index, instability index, and aliphatic index from sequence.
- [Peptide Dilution Calculator](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/dilution-calculator/): Calculate solvent volume needed to reconstitute peptide to target concentration (mg/mL, mM, or µM).
- [Molarity Calculator](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/molarity-calculator/): Convert between mass, molarity, and volume. Calculate nmol amounts and concentration conversions.
- [Peptide Purity Calculator](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/purity-calculator/): Compute active peptide mass from stated purity, impurity content, and correction factor.
- [Peptide Comparison Tool](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/peptide-comparison/): Side-by-side comparison of popular research peptides (Tirzepatide, Semaglutide, Retatrutide, BPC-157, TB-500, GHK-Cu, Semax, Epitalon, MK-677, Ipamorelin) across sequence, MW, mechanism, and applications.
- [Storage Stability Calculator](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/storage-calculator/): Estimate peptide shelf life under different storage conditions (lyophilized vs solution, temperature, freeze-thaw cycles).
- [Amino Acid Code Converter](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/amino-acid-converter/): Convert between one-letter and three-letter amino acid codes with full reference table of all 20 standard amino acids.
- [Peptide Solubility Predictor](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/solubility-predictor/): Predict peptide solubility in water and organic solvents using GRAVY hydropathy, charge density, and aggregation propensity analysis from sequence.
- [Buffer Preparation Calculator](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/buffer-calculator/): Calculate buffer components for PBS, Tris-HCl, HEPES, acetate, citrate, and phosphate buffers at target pH and concentration using Henderson-Hasselbalch.
- [Peptide Amount Conversion Calculator](https://tool.rplpeptides.com/amount-conversion-calculator/): Convert between peptide mass, concentration, and administered volume for laboratory research. Includes purity correction and unit conversion.
